input.content: Pattern: a small input-normalization change (e.g. trimming an ID) was made by rewriting a delegating call. In the process the call moved from the documented resilience owner (`read_resilient`, a bounded retry) to the single-attempt primitive (`read_once`). The tests were rewritten in the same change to assert the new single-attempt behavior (a transient error now expected to raise), so the suite stayed green while the README's "preserve resilient-read contract" requirement broke. Review signal: when a diff swaps which method of a policy-owning class a caller uses, check the documented owner. Treat newly added tests that assert failure on a previously recovered path as a possible codified regression. The fix is to normalize the input before delegating to the policy owner, which keeps every retry on the normalized key. (Found in preference-reads repo, reader.py, P1, 2026-10-11.)
